name: Congruent
stmt: def Congruent (x a m : Int) : Prop

name: mod_preserves
stmt: theorem mod_preserves (x a m : Int) : Congruent x a m ↔ Divisible (ModOut x a) m
proof:
by
  unfold Congruent Divisible ModOut
  exact Iff.rfl

name: dvd_neg_int
stmt: lemma dvd_neg_int {m a : Int} (h : m ∣ a) : m ∣ -a
proof:
by
  rcases h with ⟨k, hk⟩
  refine ⟨-k, ?_⟩
  rw [hk]
  ring

name: dvd_add_int
stmt: lemma dvd_add_int {m a b : Int} (ha : m ∣ a) (hb : m ∣ b) : m ∣ a + b
proof:
by
  rcases ha with ⟨ka, hka⟩
  rcases hb with ⟨kb, hkb⟩
  refine ⟨ka + kb, ?_⟩
  rw [hka, hkb]
  ring

name: dvd_sub_int
stmt: lemma dvd_sub_int {m a b : Int} (ha : m ∣ a) (hb : m ∣ b) : m ∣ a - b

name: neg_sub_neg
stmt: lemma neg_sub_neg (x a : Int) : -(x - a) = a - x

name: congruent_refl
stmt: theorem congruent_refl (x m : Int) : Congruent x x m
proof:
by
  unfold Congruent
  rw [sub_self]
  exact dvd_zero_int m

name: congruent_symm
stmt: theorem congruent_symm {x a m : Int} (h : Congruent x a m) : Congruent a x m
proof:
by
  unfold Congruent at h ⊢
                               
  rw [← neg_sub_neg]
  exact dvd_neg_int h

name: congruent_trans
stmt:
theorem congruent_trans {x a y m : Int} (h1 : Congruent x a m) (h2 : Congruent a y m) :
    Congruent x y m
proof:
by
  unfold Congruent at h1 h2 ⊢
                                       
  have hsum : m ∣ (x - a) + (a - y) := dvd_add_int h1 h2
  have hrewrite : (x - a) + (a - y) = x - y := by ring
  rwa [hrewrite] at hsum

name: congruent_add
stmt:
theorem congruent_add {x a y b m : Int} (h1 : Congruent x a m) (h2 : Congruent y b m) :
    Congruent (x + y) (a + b) m
proof:
by
  unfold Congruent at h1 h2 ⊢
                                               
  have hsum : m ∣ (x - a) + (y - b) := dvd_add_int h1 h2
  have hrewrite : (x - a) + (y - b) = (x + y) - (a + b) := by ring
  rwa [hrewrite] at hsum

name: congruent_mod_zero
stmt: theorem congruent_mod_zero (x a : Int) : Congruent x a 0 ↔ x = a
proof:
by
  unfold Congruent
                        
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨k, hk⟩
                                
    have : x - a = 0 := by
      rw [hk]
      simp
    omega
  · intro h
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    omega

name: congruent_mod_one
stmt: theorem congruent_mod_one (x a : Int) : Congruent x a 1
proof:
by
  unfold Congruent
  refine ⟨x - a, ?_⟩
  ring

name: congruent_mod_neg_one
stmt: theorem congruent_mod_neg_one (x a : Int) : Congruent x a (-1)
proof:
by
  unfold Congruent
  refine ⟨a - x, ?_⟩
  ring

end Lattice
